missionSettings.description:
PALA invades Puget Sound by sea, air and road; BDF defends from Tacoma. A long war (7.5 hours; the first fleets arrive after about two). Both sides can be joined.

BDF: hold JBLM, Fort Lewis FOB, the Port of Tacoma and the Narrows until T+450, or sink all 5 PALA Hyperions and then destroy the PALA Strategic HQ.
PALA: take those four sites.

About 35 AI aircraft fly at once (players come on top, each lowering his side's AI by half an aircraft); every aircraft takes off from its own side's fields, except PALA strike packages, heli-lifts and BDF relief, which enter low at the map border.

Needs NOCustomMaps 1.4.2+ and the Cascadia map, build cm.cascadia.d7766d89; everyone in a session needs the same build. NOCloudDeck is optional and only visual (cloud deck and rain).

Full briefing in game. github.com/netmaster296/CascadiaFalling

CASCADIA FALLING, a 7.5-hour war (T+ is real minutes; the clock runs at 10x). PALA attacks Puget Sound from the Pacific and the straits of Juan de Fuca and Georgia; BDF defends from Tacoma. Both sides can be joined.

FLEETS start far out: the western carrier group reaches Port Townsend about T+138 and Commencement Bay about T+297, the northern one Elliott Bay about T+353, the I-5 column the JBLM gate about T+288; the last main force about T+353. A carrier group is led by a Hyperion, a Dynamo destroyer and three Shard corvettes; a surface group by a Dynamo destroyer and two Shard corvettes, each with patrol boats and landing craft. Until then: air raids, radar strikes, heli-lifts and landings.

WEATHER: thunderstorm dawn, clear by about T+30. Nights (full moon): T+63-135, T+207-279, T+351-423. AIR: about 35 AI aircraft fly at once, both sides together (BDF up to 15, PALA up to 20; players come on top, each lowering his side's AI by half an aircraft), and a side's hangars hold back before its scripted waves. BDF opens with 12 fighters from its own fields and has three relief waves of four Ifrit. Every aircraft takes off from a field or carrier its side owns; only PALA strike packages, heli-lifts and BDF relief enter at the map border, low (about 1,500 m above the highest ground ahead), with full tanks.

ESCALATION: nuclear weapons are cleared at a score of 900, strategic launchers at 3000; each side keeps a warhead reserve the AI never uses. BDF WINS by holding JBLM, Fort Lewis FOB, the Port of Tacoma and the Narrows until T+450 (this ends the war), or by sinking all 5 PALA Hyperions and then destroying the PALA Strategic HQ, which appears on Texada Island (grid A7) when the last one sinks; PALA is then told to defend it. PALA WINS by taking those four sites.
JBLM, Fort Lewis, the port and the Narrows are PALA's. Tacoma has fallen.

Every PALA Hyperion is on the bottom. The invasion has lost its carriers, but the war is not over: reconnaissance has found the PALA Strategic HQ on Texada Island (grid A7), a factory town built round PALA's enrichment plant. BDF: destroy all of it to end the war. PALA: defend it (new objective).
The PALA Strategic HQ is destroyed. PALA has no strategic core left; BDF wins.
Tacoma held. Relief forces are crossing the Columbia.
